summary: ESS Tech, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a registered direct offering of 6,400,000 common shares at $0.50 per share, raising approximately $2.5 million in net proceeds. Concurrently, the company issued warrants to purchase 12,800,000 shares at $0.50, exercisable after stockholder approval for five years. Proceeds are for working capital and repaying about $1.5 million of a promissory note. Roth Capital Partners acted as placement agent, receiving a 7% cash fee and a warrant for 320,000 shares. This is a routine equity financing, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle remains beyond normal dilution overhang.
